operation: On the v2 backing at the G4b-1 corrective tip (the popover now closes only when the Group edit applied): a seeded Show whose Group definition Pulse pair holds Clips g-a 0+2000 and g-b 3000+2000 joined by a 1 s crossfade lt-pair. Isolate the Group, open the crossfade's Layer Transition Details, set Duration to 2.5 s (first capture; the applied edit closes the popover), then open it again and press Reset to Cut (second capture). The third capture renders the stored v2 record (GET /api/shows) from the same run: lt-pair 2500 ms with g-b at 4500, then no Transition with g-b back at 2000. The refused-edit path, which keeps the popover open, cannot be triggered in the browser without injecting a fault. The tracer 'keeps the popover open when the group-occurrence door rejects a Reset to Cut' covers it.
